technical_and_design_decisions: AWS EC2 instances will be used to provision the Kafka and RabbitMQ benchmarking environments, matching recommended specs from baseline LinkedIn performance benchmarks.
Built-in Kafka performance scripts (`kafka-producer-perf-test.sh` and `kafka-consumer-perf-test.sh`) will be used to run throughput and latency benchmarks.
Spring XD module descriptions will be added directly into Javadoc module-level/class-level comments and rendered into user-facing documentation.

Build scripts (Gradle/Maven) will be updated to bundle and upload RPM artifacts directly to the designated `spring.io` repo location (`http://repo.spring.io/libs-release-local/org/springframework/xd/spring-xd/1.1.0.RELEASE/`).
assumptions: AWS accounts and cloud permissions are readily available for provisioning benchmarking infrastructure.
Spring XD 1.1.0.RELEASE build infrastructure and Artifactory repository publish permissions are accessible.
Existing Spring XD module list is finalized and requires textual documentation without architectural code refactoring.
Benchmarking results for both RabbitMQ and Kafka will be published internally on the project wiki for developer reference.

activities.activity_description: Research and specify required EC2 instance types, storage, network configurations, and Kafka parameters (producers, consumers, topic partitions, JVM settings) to support performance testing (U7, U8).
Deploy Kafka on AWS EC2, run benchmark suites using in-built performance utilities, reproduce baseline LinkedIn metrics, and document results (U5).
Set up RabbitMQ benchmark cluster, execute load testing for Spring XD integration scenarios, and document reference performance metrics (U1).
Audit all existing Spring XD modules and author comprehensive high-level Javadoc comments and user documentation detailing module purpose and capabilities (U2, U4).
Document changes to message headers between 1.0 and 1.1 releases and create a wiki troubleshooting guide for batch-job serialization issues (U6).
Update build scripts and publishing pipelines to build and deploy Spring XD RPM packages directly to spring.io repository (U3).
